### Diff-aware (automatic when on a feature branch with no URL)

Substitute the detected base for `main`:

```bash
git diff main...HEAD --name-only
git log main..HEAD --oneline
```

Map changed files to pages. Controllers and routes map to their URL paths; views and components to the pages that render them; models and services to the pages whose flows use them; styles to the pages that include them.

**Non-UI files still map to pages.** For a changed prompt template, find the feature that sends it (search the app for the template name) and open the page where its response is shown, then trigger it with a realistic input and read the rendered result. For a changed config file, open the pages whose behavior depends on that setting. For infrastructure or build changes, the whole app is affected: run Quick mode.

**If no page can be identified:** do not skip browser testing. Run Quick mode: homepage, top 5 navigation targets, every interactive element on those pages, console checked after each action.

Find the running app (supplied URL, then local ports 3000/4000/8080, then staging/preview from the PR) and ask the user for a URL only if none respond.
